data.description_html:
What to Submit

  • Your project: a short demo video (1 to 3 minutes, a screen recording is fine) and a public GitHub, GitLab, or BitBucket repo URL. Reviewers won't clone or run code, so the video has to show it working.
  • A short description: what it does, who it's for, what you learned.
data.description_text:
What to Submit

Your project: a short demo video (1 to 3 minutes, a screen recording is fine) and a public GitHub, GitLab, or BitBucket repo URL. Reviewers won't clone or run code, so the video has to show it working.
A short description: what it does, who it's for, what you learned.

fields.label: Are you submitting as an individual, a team, or an organization?
Eligibility-confirmation
fields.description: I confirm that I (and all teammates) meet the eligibility requirements in the Official Rules, including being the age of majority where we reside, and that this project was newly created during the Submission Period using the Devpost Learn Skill Pack.

fields.label: Which of these did you actually use? Check all that apply.
Did the cost of AI (subscription, tokens, credits) affect what you did?
options: No, I never thought about it
It made me cut scope or switch to a cheaper model
I hit a usage limit or paywall
It stopped me from doing something I wanted to do

fields.label: Now, how confident are you that you could plan and build a small, maintainable project with a coding agent?
If we could fix one thing before the next person tries this, what should it be?
What kind of value did your project create for you? (select all that apply)
options: Let me do something I couldn't do before

fields.label: Tell us more about the value your project provides for you?
fields.description: This is *super* helpful to us in learning how to improve the learning hackathons over time.
